The dive's own red-team caution still stands: the market marked AECOM down twice for disclosed reasons, a November 2025 guidance cut and August 2026's $337 million legacy-contract charge that cut FY2026 FCF guidance to roughly $300 million against the $684.9 million base. The two S5 indicators (data-center-moratoria and minor-nsr-permits) remain tripped on the 2026-09-24 $58.52 close. What the weekend decides: whether a bounce that is only 2% inside the zone, on one price source per day, is the entry the dive wanted or a retest in waiting, and whether to refresh the dive before 2026-12-04.
